brannoc_chained_early: ^A big man sits against the back wall with a chain from his ankle to a ring in the stone. He watches the door, not you.
^"Garrow has the key. Garrow has all the keys. Sorry. You didn't ask."

b: ^ A big man sits against the back wall of the hall with a chain from his ankle to a ring in the stone. He looks at what's left of Captain Garrow for a long time.
^ Brannoc is still sitting by the ring in the wall. He's found the key on Garrow and not used it.

brannoc_chained: ^"Brannoc. I was Redhand. I tried to leave twice. The second time he chained me here so the others could see what leaving looked like."

b: ^"You left too. I can tell. You stand like someone who's stopped waiting to be shouted at. How did you do it? Sorry. Later."
^"He fed me when he remembered. He mostly remembered. That's the nicest thing I'll say about him."

brannoc_chained: ^"The robes paid him to dig. I heard them count it. I'd like to know what for. I'd like to see it through, if you'll have me."

c-0: ^He unlocks the chain himself, which takes him three tries, and stands up slowly, as if he expects the ceiling to object.
c-1: ^"I'll be here. I'm good at being here."

b: ^ "I'll go first through doors. I'm the widest. It's the one thing I'm best at."
^ "Your company's full. That's all right. I'll wait at the inn in Thornwick. I'm good at waiting. Sorry. I said that."

s0: ^Brannoc falls into step and waits for you to say something first.
s1: ^"Sorry. Were you going to say something? Go on."
s2: ^Brannoc is turning a link of old chain over in his fingers. He puts it away when he sees you looking.

b: ^ "I keep thinking about them down there. Nobody came, and they stayed anyway. We came, in the end. Late. But we came."

brannoc_greet_fallen: ^Brannoc looks back the way you came, where
^. Sorry. You know that. I just wanted it said."
brannoc_topics: ^We found the paymaster's boxes in the Keep.
^We stood with the legion. Five waves.
^Is there anything you need to settle?
brannoc_debts_offer: ^"Garrow's sergeants. The ones who kept my chain oiled. They're still in the Keep, and they think I owe them."
^"I don't. But they'll say so every time we pass, loudly, with crossbows. I'd like it settled before it follows us."

c-0: ^"Three of them. They lead the others in, every so often, shouting. You'll know them by the shouting."
c-1: ^"No. Sorry. They'll keep. They always did."

brannoc_debts_active: ^"Wickham Keep. Three sergeants. Stay in a room long enough and one comes to you shouting. They never learned not to."
brannoc_debts_turnin: ^"That's done, then. I thought I'd feel something. I feel like sitting down. Sorry. I'll stand."
brannoc_box_offer: ^"The paymaster kept the robes' coin in the Keep's strongroom, down in the Barracks, not with Garrow. He trusted nobody. Not Garrow, not the men, not himself. So two boxes, in two places."
^"I'd like to see whose seal is on the purses. Garrow never asked. I'm asking."

c-0: ^"Two chests in the Barracks, the Keep's second floor. He'd hide them where he'd have to walk past them twice a day, to be sure they were still there."
c-1: ^"The coin's not going anywhere. That was always the paymaster's whole idea."

brannoc_box_active: ^"Two chests in the Barracks, the Keep's second floor. He'd keep them close to the doors, where he could count them on his way past."
brannoc_box_turnin: ^Brannoc tips a purse into his hand and holds the wax to the light. It's red, the colour of a coal just before it goes out, with no crest in it, only a thumbprint.
^"Lords put lions on their wax. This is somebody who likes fire and doesn't like names." He pockets one. "Sorry. I'll give it to Sister Ilse. She'll want to read it twice."
brannoc_standing_offer: ^"Osric says there's a legion in the barrows that held a road for three hundred years because nobody told them to stop."
^"I left everything I was ever in. Twice. I'd like to stand somewhere once, with somebody who didn't. Even if they're dead. Especially if."

c-0: ^"The Old Barrows. The Long Gallery, the second floor, its last hall, where they stand in rows. Five waves, and nobody steps out. Sorry. I know you'll step out if you have to. I mean I won't."
c-1: ^"They've waited a long time. They'll understand."

brannoc_standing_active: ^"The Old Barrows. The Long Gallery's last hall, the second floor. Five waves. I've been practising standing still. It's harder than it looks."
brannoc_standing_turnin: ^Brannoc takes the old chain out of his pocket, all of it but one link, and works that link open with his thumbs until it bends.
^"There. I've kept one. The rest is yours. It's not much. It held me for a year. Maybe it'll hold something for you."
brannoc_digging: ^"I don't know. That's the honest answer. Sorry, it's not a good one."
^"The robes came once a month, paid Garrow, and asked for nothing to come up. Just the digging. Downward. Toward the chapel, I think. They listened to the ground like it might answer."
brannoc_garrow: ^"He collected. Tolls, tithes, debts. Men. He wrote everything down in a book, and if your name was in the book you owed him until he crossed it out."
^"He never crossed anything out. I checked, once. That was the first time I left."

s0: ^"Right. I'll be just behind you. Or in front, at doors."
s1: ^Brannoc nods and falls back half a step.
